item.title: Shillingford demolishes hapless Zimbabwe side
item.description: Shane Shillingford, tore through a hapless Zimbabwe side snatching 6 for 49 in the second innings to reduce the visitors to 107 all out on the morning of the third day in the first test in Kensington, Barbados.

item.title: Scientists discover evidence of God particle which may prove the Big Bang theory
item.description: Physicists working at the Large Hadron Collider in Geneva announced today the discovery of the ‘God particle’ or the subatomic particle known as a Higgs boson, which will help them explain why the universe is in its current form.

item.title: CADRES poll find Dominicans most concerned about unemployment
item.description: As part of its mid-term review, the Dominica Labour Party (DLP) commissioned CADRES to conduct an assessment of its performance nationally, using 13 of the 18 constituencies that it currently represents in the Dominican Parliament as a barometer.

item.title: Think-tank alliance identifies eight shifts needed for sustainability
item.description: A new international alliance of research institutes has identified eight major shifts that must take place for humanity to achieve sustainable development.

item.title: Judges or House Slaves  How the courts failed the people of Dominica
item.description: The recent Court of Appeal judgment in the Dual Citizenship matter handed down by the Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court seriously reduced the supremacy of the Constitution of Dominica and insulted the intelligence of the people.

item.title: Government lawyer refers to Dominica government opposition as Al Qaeda terrorists
item.description: Lennox Lawrence close confidant and lawyer for Dominica’s prime minister Roosevelt Skerrit has called for members of the Dominica Labour Party to “go after” members of the opposition United Workers Party (UWP).

item.title: LIAT to begin daily non stop flights between Dominica and San Juan Puerto Rico
item.description: LIAT the Caribbean Regional carrier says that it will now operate daily non-stop flights to and from San Juan to Melville Hall Dominica starting on April 1, 2013.

item.title: Ross University School of Medicine and Dominica sign historic partnership agreement
item.description: Ross University School of Medicine (RUSM) recently announced that it has renewed its partnership agreement with the Commonwealth of Dominica.

item.title: Not an illegal but an accidental Prime Minister in Dominica
item.description: Like thousands of fair minded and rational thinking Dominicans at home and abroad, I was disappointed by the ECSC’s vindication of Roosevelt Skerrit and Petter St. Jean in the citizenship case.
